## The Challenge

Fun.com's Halloween business lives and dies by relevance. In 2025, they faced:

1,500+ misspellings of "Wednesday Addams"

Legacy search couldn't handle typos, causing customer bounces during peak demand.

Hourly trend shifts driven by TikTok

Higher intent capture across journeys

25,000+ SKUs live during peak season

Massive catalog complexity made relevant discovery nearly impossible.

Legacy SOLR search failing on long-tail

High bounce rates from irrelevant recommendations and zero results.

"Search could not handle basic mistypes or mispellings without heavy handed redirects to broad listing pages."

— Director of Ecommerce, Fun.com

## The challenge: cold traffic activation

BRUNT Workwear faced a common e-commerce challenge: most visitors arrived as cold traffic — anonymous users with no browsing history, no account, and no signals beyond their entry page.

High bounce rates from first-time visitors

Traditional recommendation systems struggled with 'cold start' visitors, defaulting to generic bestsellers.

Low engagement with product recommendations

Static recommendations didn't resonate with visitors who had no established preferences.

Generic upsells that didn't match visitor intent

One-size-fits-all upsells failed to capture the specific needs of each customer.

Missed revenue opportunities from unactivated traffic

Without personalization from the first click, valuable conversion opportunities were lost.

"We needed a way to understand our visitors immediately — not after they create an account or browse 10 pages. Malachyte promised to solve exactly that problem."

— BRUNT Workwear Team

Fun.com didn't overhaul everything at once. They followed a phased rollout designed to prove impact quickly and expand with confidence.
